plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing plan built for a beginner with short 30-minute sessions and an endurance priority. Week 1 establishes simple strength baselines on the main lifts with one assessment per session so future loading is grounded and safe. The main program starts in Week 2 and builds aerobic capacity, repeatable effort, and basic full-body strength with low-complexity power work kept in small doses.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baseline strength, build aerobic capacity, and groove simple full-body strength and power patterns.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the key lifts and conditioning density while keeping sessions short and recoverable around boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the strength base while expressing faster, sharper repeat efforts with lower fatigue.
